name: particle_update
describe: Per-particle physics integration in OPEN AIR (no collision): age++, motionY -= 0.04*gravity, bounding-box offset+recenter, motion *= 0.98. Snapshot (pos,motion,age,gravity,width,height) -> (new pos,motion,age,onGround). Collision is the world-coupled part excluded by construction. Golden captured live via NetheriteMod 'capture_particle' (real onUpdate, canCollide=false at y~200).
